mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, noti_type, ref_id, message) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{refId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{message})
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id, user_id, noti_type, ref_id, message, is_read, created_at FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
